name: 31364-eagle3decode-gptoss120b-tp2
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b as the target, with nvidia/gpt-oss-120b-Eagle3 as the EAGLE3 draft head. Neither is gated.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, ONE node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. EP must stay 1: at ep_size > 1 the mxfp4 expert path is declined and the experts are dequantised to bf16, 3.8x the weight bytes.
architecture: GptOssForCausalLM: 36 layers alternating sliding (window 128) and full attention, 64 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 64, hidden 2880, 128 experts with 4 active per token, vocab 201088, mxfp4 experts (~63 GB) with bf16 attention and embeddings; the draft head is one bf16 LlamaForCausalLMEagle3 decoder layer (431 MB) that shares the target embedding and lm_head.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 240 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix, seed 31364: 1024 prompt tokens and 1024 generated tokens, both EXACT, with `temperature: 0` and `ignore_eos: true` so every request runs to its full declared length.
purpose: A 120-billion-parameter chat assistant with speculative drafting, serving eight concurrent users long single-turn replies on two GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is dropped when this file is read, and the engine
# then starts without something this item declares.

model-path: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tp-size: 2

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: nvidia/gpt-oss-120b-Eagle3
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 4
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 8

# 4096, not the checkpoint's 131072: speculative decoding preallocates per-step scratch that
# scales with the declared context, for a workload whose longest request is 1024 + 1024 tokens.
context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 31364
